raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: 1.2.0

package:
  name: python-fitparse
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/f/fitparse/fitparse-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 2d691022452dea6dabad13cc6e017ca467fe8a3a895cd3ac67a50a7bb716b4a9

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - fitparse
      pip_check: true
      python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*

about:
  summary: Python library to parse ANT/Garmin .FIT files
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://www.github.com/dtcooper/python-fitparse
  documentation: https://pythonhosted.org/fitparse/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - glemaitre
    - JaRoSchm
